Name: More Wedding Venues
Author: bigeyedkitteh
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/RqSkbvW.gif[/img][/center][center][youtube]hSe9oCG61iE[/youtube]



♡ Enjoy a one-of-a-kind wedding experience with your fave Stardew Valley NPC with More Wedding Venues!

♡ Explore various wedding destinations, and schedule your ceremony to your favorite time of the day, weather, and season.

♡ Different dialogues and wedding presiders -- depending on chosen spouse, map and event mode.

♡ Can be used not only for normal weddings, but also for renewal of vows and also celebrating bestie day!



For now there are [b]5 destinations[/b] to choose from:

1. [b]Beach[/b] Wedding (custom)
2. [b]Vanilla Beach[/b] Wedding
3. [b]Garden[/b] Wedding (custom)
4. [b]Secret[/b] [b]Forest[/b] Wedding
5. [b]Chapel[/b] Wedding (custom)


[color=#f6b26b]⚠️ [/color][color=#f1c232]The Normal Wedding/Renewal of Vows/Bestie (Platonic) modes are triggered on the [b][u]same day[/u][/b] you give the pendant/bracelet and [b]after[/b] you go [b][u]back into the Farmhouse[/u][/b].[/color]



[b][u]📝Checklist Before the Ceremony
[/u][/b]
[color=#efefef]- have [/color][b]back-up saves[/b][color=#efefef] (Multi-Save mod)[/color]
[color=#efefef]- prep chosen [/color][b]outfit[/b][color=#efefef] in advance[/color]
[color=#efefef]- wait for the desired [/color][b]weather[/b][color=#efefef], and [/color][b]season[/b][color=#efefef] before proposing[/color]
[color=#efefef]- wait for desired [/color][b]time of ceremony[/b][color=#efefef] before going back inside Farmhouse after proposing[/color]
[color=#efefef]- [/color][b]clear forages[/b][color=#efefef] and [/color][b]prep lighting[/b][color=#efefef] beforehand (for the vanilla beach and secret forest weddings -- non-custom maps)[/color]


[color=#f1c232]⚠️ The original in-game wedding by Mayor Lewis will still occur after 2-3 days (didn't attempt to override this event since it's hardcoded in-game). After "paying" Mayor Lewis his "wedding tax", that's the time you're partner is officially tagged as "Spouse/Husband/Wife" in the game instead of just "Dating".[/color][/center][center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/B6tEjwS.gif[/img][/center][center]Unzip the file and paste to the[b] Mods[/b] folder in Stardew Valley. Make sure you have the following required mods:

- [b]SMAPI [/b]
- [b]Content Patcher
[/b]

The following mods aren't required but highly recommended:

- [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
- [b]Multi-Save[/b]
- [b]Platonic Friendships and Partnerships
[/b]
﻿

[color=#f1c232]More Wedding Venues is enabled by default, with location initially set to "[b]Beach Wedding[/b]", and NPCs set as "[b]Love Interest[/b]".
Remember to enable "[b]Renew Vows[/b]" if character is already married, and switch from "[b]Love Interest[/b]" to "[b]Platonic[/b]" if target NPC is considered as Bestie.[/color]

[img]https://imgur.com/mUOaSQe.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/bSe8Qr6.gif[/img][/center][center]Compatible and works with most mods, but for now, you can only [u]marry, renew vows, and celebrate bestie day[/u] with:

♡ [b]12 bachelors and bachelorettes[/b] (base game)
♡ [b]Krobus[/b]
♡ [b]June[/b] (Ridgeside Valley)*


⚠️ Other NPCs not [i]yet[/i] included above will continue to have the [b]original Stardew Valley wedding[/b] instead.
﻿


🕊️🕊️🕊️

[color=#ea9999]*If you encounter [url=https://imgur.com/IGtFuWl.png]this[/url]﻿ when marrying any NPC above during any time after [b][u]Fall Year 1[/u][/b]:


- if you don't have Ridgeside Valley mod installed:
just[b][i] ignore[/i][/b] it. This mod still works based on tests. You may also choose to simply download the Alternate version of this mod (download only 1!)

- If you got Ridgeside Valley installed:
1. just [b][i]wait for Richard[/i][/b] to come in the Farm, and
2. [b][i]visit Ridgeside Valley at least once[/i][/b] before marrying.

That message is caused by June not showing in the Relationship Menu right away until those 2 conditions above are met. But [url=https://imgur.com/OTiLmuX.png]once he's there[/url]﻿, it's all good!~👍
If you're not able to trigger the wedding event after getting in the Farmhouse and with June already in the Relationship Menu, either just wait for a few seconds to a minute for the game to refresh (depends on your system), or sleep and try the next day.

[/color]
🕊️🕊️🕊️

[u]Tested and works great with:[/u]

- [b]Platonic Partnerships and Friendships[/b]
- [b]Free Love
[/b]


[u]Compatible but works separately:[/u]

- [b]Elliott Immersive Wedding[/b] (custom Elliott's wedding outfit and arch will only show on Town and reception,
not during ceremonies in the More Wedding Venues mod)
- [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] (SVE NPCs will continue to have their wedding on Town -- for now -- instead of the venues here)
- [b]Ridgeside Valley[/b] (NPCs there except June, will continue to have their wedding on Town -- for now -- instead of the venues here)



[u]Does [b]NOT[/b] work with:[/u]

- anything [b]multiplayer[/b] (no player-to-player wedding yet; other players won't be able to join the weddings from this mod,
only the original one by Mayor Lewis in Town)
- marrying the [b]same NPC again after divorce[/b] and choosing exactly the [b]same venue[/b] chosen prior (works fine if marrying a [b][i]different NPC[/i][/b] after a divorce, or at least choosing a [b][i]different venue[/i][/b] not yet chosen before)



[u][b]Hit or Miss [/b](sometimes it worked, sometimes it didn't during tests -- can't do anything about it🤷):[/u]

- mods that change the[b] [/b]Farmhouse layout using PyTK



[u][b]NOT[/b] tested on:[/u]

- [b]Android[/b]
- [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 alpha/beta[/b][/center]
